basic_info.description: Located in the vibrant Marina District, this 1 bedroom & 1 bath, 545-square-foot apartment is perfect for those trying to enjoy the best the city has to offer! Incredibly close to Fort Mason and Fisherman's Wharf. The space features a fully-equipped kitchen with Miele appliances, a dishwasher, and a room for a king-size bed. There is an AMAZING communal rooftop with a fantastic view of the Golden Gate Bridge, an outdoor grilling area, and in-suite laundry. One secure parking spot is available for a fee ($300) and the building is pet-friendly. The owner pays for high-speed internet, water, gas, and garbage.
